scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive proof from complete binary-word enumeration by two independent standard-library implementations; all input positions are labeled and each increasing triple contributes once. A 3-deck determines all shorter subsequence multiplicities for words of length at least three.
scientific_limitations: Established only for lengths 3 through 16. Independent formal audit and all-length formula are not claimed. Unindexed prior exhaustive computations remain a possible bibliographic overlap.
title: Sharp onset of superlinear ambiguity for binary three-subsequence decks
